archive_limit: Missing condition tracks are marked ‘not archived’ and are not reconstructed from coordinates, site parameters, or a current ephemeris.
attribution_limit: Planned–unacquired means only that no strict raw frame matched the planned (night, field) multiplicity; no weather or equipment cause is assigned.

chart_contract.analytical_question: What cadence did the archived plan specify, how closely do archived starts follow it, and which observing conditions were actually archived?
chart_contract.non_color_distinction: marker shape, open fill, line style, and direct labels
chart_contract.palette_policy: hard two-root cap: GOTTA blue normal, orange near-Sun, neutrals

panels.a: planned/actual timeline by scheduler cycle and mode
panels.b: repeat-relative planned median and actual p16/median/p84 cadence
panels.c: actual minus planned start residual at matched-pair grain
panels.d: archived exposure-level Sun, Moon, and altitude/airmass tracks

definitions.cadence_anchor: actual elapsed time is reported only for field/cycle groups with a matched, timed repeat-1 exposure
definitions.conditions: direct archived values only; no ephemeris, coordinate, altitude, or airmass reconstruction

historical_near_sun_implementation: Historical near-Sun rows are the executed RA-prefix implementation: an initial solar-separation ordering was overwritten by RA sorting before prefix selection.
